KAFKA-PURSUIT.title: Pursuit
KAFKA-PURSUIT.description: Triggers when the card you play is a different type than the last card played this turn.
KAFKA-DETONATE.title: Detonate
KAFKA-DETONATE.description: Trigger all Shock on target, each dealing its damage. Shock is not consumed.
KAFKA-REWRITE.title: Rewrite
KAFKA-REWRITE.description: Select an Attack or Skill card, then choose from 3 random cards of the opposite type to replace it. Power and Status cards cannot be Rewritten. Replacement lasts this combat only.
KAFKA-STRANGE_LETTER_PROMPT: Select a Rewritten card to exhaust
KAFKA-KAFKA_EIDOLON.title: Eidolon
KAFKA-KAFKA_EIDOLON.description:
After each combat, you may skip the card reward to draw [blue]1[/blue] [color=purple]Eidolon[/color], unlocked in order E1 → E6, up to [blue]6[/blue] total.
(Tip: the chance ramps up with each attempt — soft pity.)
